clips.title: The story
paras: At a Venture Company outpost in the northern Barrens, Sputtervalve wants a device called a samophlange. He sends you southwest of the Sludge Fen to find it.

In the northern Barrens, Sputtervalve cannot explain what the Venture Company is building. The goblin engineer and tinker works in Ratchet, while the rival company experiments southwest of the Sludge Fen. Its people call one device a samophlange. Sputtervalve does not know its purpose or value, but wants to study its design before his competitors can profit from it.

The Venture Company guards its research site with armed overseers, deforesters, and machinery. Sputtervalve gives you an intercepted operating manual to help shut down the rig safely. At the central control station, you find a locked console with levers, lights, and gauges. Three control valves keep the rig's pressure in order.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".
Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.
I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
